offence_note: Theft over $1,000 and fraud over $5,000 by immigration consultant
sentence_quote: In these circumstances, I do not think if appropriate to impose a conditional sentence. General deterrence requires real jail. Accordingly, there will be a period of incarceration for one year.
note: Appeal for conditional sentence dismissed; restitution order from trial.

offence_note: Sexual assault with weapon, assault causing bodily harm, forcible confinement
sentence_quote: The appellant also seeks leave to appeal his sentence which was nine years in addition to time served.
note: Nine years in addition to time served; credit not stated.

offence_note: Two offences while avoiding arrest; dangerous driving
sentence_quote: I find a fit sentence to be one of 16 months incarceration. After giving Mr. White credit for time-served - 60 days - I impose an actual sentence of 14 months' incarceration on Counts 1 and 2
note: Additional 5-year provincial Motor Vehicle Act driving prohibition; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Occupational Health and Safety Act offence by corporation, unguarded machine injury
sentence_quote: The appeal is allowed. The sentence is varied to a fine of $40,000, plus the victim fine surcharge.
note: Corporate defendant; Crown appeal; fine raised from $7,500 to $40,000.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for trafficking; possession of marijuana
sentence_quote: a sentence of imprisonment of two years less one day served in the community under a conditional sentence order followed by one year of probation is a fit and proper sentence.
note: $500 charitable contribution as part of conditional sentence; $150 fine on marijuana count.

offence_note: Care or control of vehicle with over 80 mg alcohol
sentence_quote: I sentence you to pay a fine of $2,000.

offence_note: Manslaughter by single stabbing while intoxicated
sentence_quote: I conclude that a sentence of four years' imprisonment is a just, fit, and proportionate sentence in this case.
systemic_quote: Mr. Johnson's degree of responsibility or level of moral blameworthiness is reduced by the brevity of the act, his alcohol consumption, and his background circumstances that I have outlined previously in these reasons.

offence_note: Criminal negligence causing death (4) and bodily harm, workplace collapse
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed a sentence of three and a half years on each count to be served concurrently.

offence_note: Sexual touching, invitation to touching of stepson; anal intercourse count quashed
sentence_quote: the trial judge sentenced the appellant to five years on the anal intercourse count, and four years on the other counts, all four sentences to be served concurrently.
note: Five-year count quashed; remaining concurrent four-year sentences stand; no sentence appeal.

offence_note: Possession of methamphetamine, possession for trafficking, breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: The appellant also appeals from her sentence of time served and a 12-month probation order.
note: Victim surcharge vacated on one matter; sentence otherwise upheld.

offence_note: Participating in criminal organization activity as a lawyer
sentence_quote: Mr. Mastop, I sentence you to one year in jail.
note: Firearms not forfeited; returned to lawful owners.
